name: Litestream Open Source SQLite Replication
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 standalone SQLite replication and disaster-recovery tool; incremental replication to local files or S3-compatible storage without a software usage quota.
watch_out: Remote object storage, API requests, bandwidth and hosting may cost money; no free hosted replica is included. SQLite checkpoint/WAL and restore behavior require testing; upstream labels the project beta.
